items.guidance: The COPY of .git/refs/heads/master in the Dockerfile suggests the app reads the current commit from that file at runtime. Check where the code reads it, then supply the same value from a build argument written into the image or exposed as an environment variable, so the version display keeps working.

Find the listening port in the hapi server setup that /emailengine/server.js starts, or in the config defaults it loads, and check which environment variable or config key overrides it. Only add ENV PORT if that variable is literally PORT. Otherwise rely on EXPOSE and the app's own config variable.

Check whether server.js spawns the BullMQ consumers itself, for example as worker threads or child processes started from the main entry, and report the file and line where this happens. Report any separate worker entry file you find, and say whether it is reachable outside server.js.
